title: Verify fixed GP8 trill speed and selective normalization policy
scope: Add the missing 16th/32nd/64th public-API and pinned-consumer regression matrix for the established sixteenth-speed GP8 consumer limit.
acceptance: At the same target fret7, export plain sixteenth-, thirty-second-, and sixty-fourth-note TrillEffect.Duration values. All emit Trill=7 and the pinned consumer reports fret7 and duration16; assert beat rhythm, note fret, and unrelated effects remain unchanged.
Sixteenth input emits no trill-duration loss and strict export succeeds. Thirty-second and sixty-fourth emit exactly gp8.normalize.trill-duration at the authored note and strict refuses output.

An unrelated allowed loss cannot bypass the trill-duration loss; allowing exactly gp8.normalize.trill-duration succeeds and preserves the target fret while making the normalized duration16 explicit in Go reparse and the pinned consumer.

Register per-speed runtime assertions and independent consumer evidence in the semantic ledger. Keep arbitrary speed export partial, with the target-consumer limit recorded in the work item and catalog.
exclusions: No encoding trill speed through beat rhythm, tremolo, ornaments, or undocumented fields. No full-support promotion for sixteenth quantization.
